summary: Full-width hero over a background photo or looping video with a brand-colored shade; copy on the left (or centered), optional KPI strip at the bottom. Video gets a pause button. Layout "frame" (after IntegratedBio): the photo or video fills a rounded frame inset 12px from the page edge and the first screen; a very large headline top left, the lead bottom left, the buttons bottom right (the main one with a square arrow chip). Intro: the frame opens from a small pill in the middle, the headline and lead rise line by line out of masks, then the header and buttons arrive. Frame ignores align, proof and stats; keep the headline to 2-3 lines and the lead under 140 characters.
